ownership.quote: LangChain began its life in late 2022 as an open source project founded by Harrison Chase, who was then an engineer at machine learning startup Robust Intelligence. After generating significant developer interest, Chase transformed the project into a startup

stage.quote: Today, we’re announcing we’ve raised $125M at a $1.25B valuation to build the platform for agent engineering. ... IVP led the round alongside existing investors Sequoia, Benchmark, and Amplify, as well as new investors CapitalG and Sapphire Ventures.
stage.note: Last priced round is the October 2025 Series B ($125M at $1.25B valuation, led by IVP).

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of confirmed rounds: $10M seed (Benchmark, Apr 2023) + $25M Series A (Sequoia, Apr 2023, announced with LangSmith GA Feb 2024) + $125M Series B (IVP-led, Oct 2025)
total_funding_usd.quote: Just a week after announcing a $10 million seed investment from Benchmark, AI darling LangChain has scored even more capital... has raised between $20 million and $25 million in funding at a valuation of at least $200 million from Sequoia

last_round.quote: Today, we’re announcing we’ve raised $125M at a $1.25B valuation to build the platform for agent engineering. ... IVP led the round alongside existing investors Sequoia, Benchmark, and Amplify, as well as new investors CapitalG and Sapphire Ventures.

note: LangChain/LangSmith is the open-source-turned-commercial company behind LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith (observability/eval/deployment) and LangSmith Sandboxes (the product on this card). Founded by Harrison Chase (ex-Robust Intelligence) in late 2022. Raised $10M seed (Benchmark, Apr 2023), $25M Series A (Sequoia, Apr 2023, publicly tied to LangSmith GA announcement Feb 2024), and $125M Series B (IVP-led, Oct 2025) at a $1.25B valuation, making it a unicorn. No accelerator/incubator affiliation found.
